title: Creating an account with Apple ID can be unsettling

labels.name: T-Enhancement
labels.description: New features, changes in functionality, improvements in performance, or user-facing enhancements.

body: Moved from https://github.com/vector-im/element-web/issues/19222 ### Description ### Your use case #### What would you like to do? I want account creation UI to be clearer. #### Why would you like to do it? I would be more likely to create a Matrix account to communicate with family and friends, or get involved in the online communities I follow. #### How would you like to achieve it? I would like to have more explicit and detailed information in the different views regarding: * what is expected from me * what access element has to my Apple account --- # What happened during the registration When trying to register on matrix.org, after logging in with my Apple ID, I'm presented a screen asking me to type in a username. I don't know what username it wants and what it will be used for: my Apple ID one? The one I want on Matrix.org? It would be easier for me to understand what it expects if it told me "Enter the username you would like to use as a MatrixID. This username cannot be changed later and will serve to identify you". After clicking on `Continue` it tells me staging.element.io is going to get access to my account. Will it be able to access to my Apple account? It's a sensitive account, will staging.element.io use my bank details to buy things? It would be less frightening for me if I understood what staging.element.io can do with my account. To help me, the page could display a list of things it can do with my account. ### Have you considered any alternatives? _No response_ ### Additional context _No response_ - thibaultamartin
